title: Measure the reader/probes/scorer integration gap: what blocks a first recorded reader attempt
body:
## Goal
Measure, report, do not fix. The citation thread is closed (#905, review #906 CLEAR). The next method gap named in `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md` `## Gaps` is the row "reader / probes / scorer integration" (PARTIAL: zero reader attempts, scorer runs only on synthetic controls, `benchmark_executed: false`). Write `benchmark/challenges/reader-integration-0212.md` that states, with file:line evidence: (a) what the method in `docs/perpetua/evaluation.md` requires for reader attempts, fresh-session runs and separate fidelity/correctness/grounding scoring; (b) what exists now in the repository (score.py entry points and input format for answer records, any reader adapter or runner scripts under `benchmark/scripts/`, probe definitions); (c) the concrete blockers to one recorded reader attempt on a public dev fixture, each classified as needs-LabVIEW, needs-owner, needs-product-code, or doable-now-as-preparation; (d) one recommended next task (or the evidence that none is ready), with its expected gain and a verification command.
Change no file other than the new Markdown file. No session can run LabVIEW: claim nothing about native behaviour. Do not start writing a reader, adapter or product code under `src/`.
Expected gain: the next shaper reads `## Recommendation` and orders the next integration step without re-surveying.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `benchmark/challenges/reader-integration-0212.md` exists with headings `## Requirements`, `## Existing`, `## Blockers`, `## Recommendation`
- [ ] every blocker line has a class (needs-LabVIEW, needs-owner, needs-product-code, doable-now-as-preparation) and a file:line reference
- [ ] `## Recommendation` names one task (or states none is ready and why) with expected gain and a verification command
- [ ] `git status --porcelain` shows only the new file (no `__pycache__`)

## Verification
python3 -c "t=open('benchmark/challenges/reader-integration-0212.md').read();assert all(h in t.splitlines() for h in ['## Requirements','## Existing','## Blockers','## Recommendation']);assert 'doable-now-as-preparation' in t or 'needs-' in t;print('OK')"

## Context
- Gap source: `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md` row "reader / probes / scorer integration" (cites EV:78, EV:40, `scorer-probe-0164.md:3,5,54`, `README.md:6`, `protocol.md:83-90`).
- Do not re-survey other gaps (gap-0160, scorer-probe-0164, next-gap-0202 are done); cite them.
- Role tools: if the CLI says "No such tool available: Read. Read is disabled for this session", that is the native-tool refusal; propose the same operation as a JSON action (orchestrator skill section "Role tools", Policymaker #854). Do not stop on it.
- Grep is literal-substring only; one literal pattern per call.
- If you run benchmark Python, use `python3 -B -I`; score.py generation/--check need LABVIEW_ENVIRONMENT. Do not `git commit` (the parent commits).

## Budget
Read: `docs/perpetua/evaluation.md` whole (Polish); `benchmark/challenges/next-gap-0202.md`; `benchmark/challenges/scorer-probe-0164.md`; `benchmark/README.md`; `benchmark/protocol.md` lines 70-130 only; Glob `benchmark/scripts/*` then Grep for `def main`, `argparse` and `answer` in `benchmark/scripts/score.py` and Read only those ranges. Do not read `benchmark/results/challenges.json` or case JSON files whole. Short command output; report early if blocked.
